sql: /* Query 5: filter3_agg1_join1 (player, team) */ SELECT player.team, AVG(player.fiba_world_cup) AS avg_player_fiba_world_cup FROM player JOIN team ON player.team = team.team_name WHERE player.nba_championships < 0 OR player.age >= 42 GROUP BY player.team

fiba_world_cup.description: number of FIBA World Cup titles the player has won (e.g., 1).

team.description: the current NBA team the player belongs to, or the last NBA team the player joined if not currently active (e.g., Los Angeles Lakers).
